questions.q:
The compound (X) on
(i) heating in the presence of anhydrous $AlCl_3$ and HCl gas gives 2,4-dimethyl pentane
(ii) aromatization gives toluene and
(iii) cyclisation gives methyl cyclohexane
The correct name of compound (X) is:
questions.explain: Compound (X) must be an alkane since it undergoes isomerisation with anhydrous $AlCl_3$/HCl to give branched alkanes like 2,4-dimethylpentane. Aromatisation of $n$-heptane over oxides of transition metals at high temperature yields toluene, and its cyclisation gives methylcyclohexane. Hence, compound (X) is $n$-heptane.
